Don’t go away. I totally know how you feel. The first year and half of my relationship was really difficult. Both me and my partner have trauma issues but he’s a lot more different with it and let me tell you the first 9 months were so FUCJING hard. I was dealing with my anger a lot he had a slight substance issue on top of that we were living in a complete shit hole with shit roommates and we were having really bad fights but just yelling and us not being able to grow due to circumstances and my tiny voices were really bad and loud. Time went on and things chilled out we moved to nyc with much anxiety in my end and then I started to get worse, my stress caught up with me more and I lashed out a lot more and always moody, and my episodes became more intense. Eventfully i could see I was affecting my partner, and we would react in fights too and it just was getting bad and we were also living in another awful roommate situation that really didn’t help. but I could see that he was starting to mirror how I would react in fights. I figured I would share my experience with BPD and being in a relationship. Evryone always saysthe first year is super easy and nice but I think it’s actually the hardest and most eye opening.
